description: Asks The Deployer's team to do it for the user: launch (put an app online in the user's own cloud account), launch_secure (the same, with exposed keys and other security problems fixed first) or move (move an app from another host, such as Heroku, into it). Tells the team, and returns the price, the delivery promise and the link where the user finishes the order and pays. Never charges anything. Needs an API key.

note.description: Anything the team should know, such as the current host or a deadline

repo.description: The repository, if there is one
